title: Jacob's ladders, new classes of sum variants of almost linear formula and corresponding $ζ$-functionals and $ζ$-equivalents of the Fermat-Wiles theorem
summary: In this paper we obtain new classes of the second generation of new $ζ$-functionals and corresponding $ζ$-equivalents of the Fermat-Wiles theorem. These are based on sets of elementary rectangular $ζ$-signals generated by the Gramm's sequence.
